parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Describes the type of functionality that {{object}} is representing.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Human-readable description of the {{object}}. e.g. a more detailed description of {{param|Type}}.

parameters.name: Values
parameters.description: The current value reading of this {{object}} in units defined in {{param|Unit}}.

parameters.name: ValueNames
parameters.description: The names of the values expressed in {{param|Values}}.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.description: The date and time when {{param|Values}} has been changed to the current values.

parameters.name: LastContactTime
parameters.description: The date and time in UTC when the {{object}} has received data.

object.description: MultiLevelSensor is used to reflect the functionality of a sensor that reports multiple {{param|Values}} with the same {{param|Unit}}.
